Project Vision:
### Project Vision

Imagine a world where the hiring process is swift, transparent, and remarkably efficient. Our groundbreaking CV screening and interview platform is set to revolutionize the recruitment landscape for both job applicants and HR managers. Leveraging the power of AI, our platform meticulously filters through CVs, distinguishing genuine talent from the noise of mass applications. No more sifting through endless piles of resumes—our AI does it for you, pinpointing the best candidates with unparalleled accuracy.

But we don't stop there. Our AI-driven digital interviews delve deeper, asking personalized questions and analyzing responses to ensure only the most suitable candidates make it through. This not only saves precious time but also elevates the quality of hires, aligning perfectly with your company's needs.

Transparency is at our core. Applicants receive clear, actionable feedback at every stage, transforming the often opaque hiring process into a journey of continuous improvement. HR managers are kept in the loop with real-time notifications and seamless integration with Google APIs for effortless scheduling.

Designed as a Progressive Web App, our platform is accessible on any device, ensuring a smooth, user-friendly experience. Hosted on AWS but securely storing data locally, we combine the best of both worlds—scalability and security.

Join us in redefining recruitment. Embrace the future of hiring with our innovative platform, where efficiency meets excellence.

Revenue Models.Rationale: Job applicants pay a one-time fee or a small fee per application to upload their CVs and participate in the digital interview process. This model ensures that only serious candidates apply, reducing the number of mass applications. The revenue is received by the platform provider.

HR managers pay a recurring subscription fee for access to the platform's features, including job posting creation, AI-driven CV screening, digital interviews, and detailed analytics. This model provides consistent revenue for the platform provider and ensures HR managers have continuous access to the service.
